```{=html}
<script>
function filterCards() {
  const query = document.getElementById('cardFilterInput').value.toLowerCase().trim();
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ex-card');
  
  cards.forEach(card => {
    const text = card.textContent.toLowerCase();
    const keywords = (card.getAttribute('data-keyword') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (text.includes(query) || keywords.includes(query)) {
      card.style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
      card.style.display = 'none';
    }
  });
}

function setQuickFilter(region, btn) {
  // Update button active state
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  btn.classList.add('active');
  
  document.getElementById('cardFilterInput').value = '';
  const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.ex-card');
  
  cards.forEach(card => {
    if (region === 'all') {
      card.style.display = 'flex';
    } else {
      const reg = card.getAttribute('data-region') || '';
      if (reg.includes(region)) {
        card.style.display = 'flex';
      } else {
        card.style.display = 'none';
      }
    }
  });
}
</script>
```
